preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::3] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a) and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b) for a, b in zip([sorted([int(x) for x in line.split()]) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::3] if line.strip()], [sorted([int(x) for x in line.split()]) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[3::3] if line.strip()]))
preconditions.description: Elements of multisets a and b are integers between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: sum([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::3] if line.strip()]) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either YES or NO (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().upper() == 'YES') == (can_match(a, b)) for line, (a, b) in zip(stdout_lines, zip([sorted([int(x) for x in line.split()]) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::3] if line.strip()], [sorted([int(x) for x in line.split()]) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[3::3] if line.strip()])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is YES if and only if multiset b can be transformed into multiset a using the allowed operations (doubling or halving with floor), and NO otherwise.
